# `hero`

Helper: `hero(title, sub, icon, { over, actions, rail: [done, total], small })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (gradient hero) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaHero` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Gradient band (brand-600 to brand-500), decorative icon at 10% opacity, optional kicker (eyebrow), title (24/600), sub line, actions on the right; optional session rail.

## Variants

- Default
- `small`: icon becomes a 24px corner mark (Patient Mobile home)
- `rail: [done, total]`: one rail segment per session

## States

- Buttons on it use the `light` variant

## Tokens

brand-600, brand-500, brand-100, brand-200, surface, radius-hero

## Do

- Use it for identity areas (patient home, welcome)
- Keep text short: title, one sub line, one action

## Don't

- Never place it behind tables, prescriptions or doctor notes
- Do not stack two heroes on a page

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Web-only use; the app uses it on home tabs. Padding 24, title 24.

## Mobile (390)

Patient Mobile frames: title 21, max width 290, kicker tracking .06em; actions go below the text.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Identity areas only, never behind tables or notes. Actions (e.g. the period badge) sit on the right, below the text at 390. `rail` draws the session rail (one segment per session, `done` lit) and `small` makes the icon a 24px corner mark: Patient Mobile home. Use `light(...)` for a button on it. **web-only use** (app uses it on home tabs)
